title: Higher-Call Signed Path Valuation Audit: Universal Z_3-Coset Invariant, Sign-Schedule Invariance, and Exact 1/3 Non-Unit Fraction

theorems.name: Universal Z_3-Coset Invariant and Balanced Sign Annihilation
theorems.statement: For the 1-site root-pair digit vectors beta_0 = (1, 0), beta_1 = (-1, 1), beta_2 = (0, -1), the linear functional Phi(x, y) = x - y satisfies Phi(beta_t) === 1 (mod 3) for all t in {0, 1, 2}. Consequently, for any sign schedule epsilon = (epsilon_1, ..., epsilon_k) in {-1, +1}^k with net sign S(epsilon) = sum_l epsilon_l, every single-path sum V_epsilon(t) = (X, Y) = sum_l epsilon_l beta_(t_l) satisfies X - Y === S(epsilon) (mod 3). Single-path mod-3 vanishing V_epsilon(t) === (0, 0) (mod 3) occurs if and only if S(epsilon) === 0 (mod 3) (which holds for all balanced even schedules k = 2m, S(epsilon) = 0, with exact integer zero-sum count sum_(a+b+c=m) (m!/(a!b!c!))^2, whereas unsigned schedules (+1)^k require 3 | k with integer zero-sum count k! / ((k/3)!)^3).

theorems.name: Exact Sign-Schedule Invariance of Paired Path Differences
theorems.statement: For every call count k >= 1 and every sign schedule epsilon in {-1, +1}^k, the paired path-difference distribution Delta_epsilon(t, u) = V_epsilon(t) - V_epsilon(u) over uniform (t, u) in {0, 1, 2}^k x {0, 1, 2}^k is identical to the unsigned path-difference distribution Delta_((+1)^k)(t, u) via the coordinate-swap involution (t_l, u_l) <-> (u_l, t_l) on calls with epsilon_l = -1. Consequently, all 3-adic valuation strata and the IID population collision law over Z_(3^d)^n are strictly invariant across all 2^k sign schedules.

theorems.name: Sublattice Congruence Delta_X === Delta_Y (mod 3) and Universal 1/3 Non-Unit Fraction
theorems.statement: For every path pair (t, u) in {0, 1, 2}^k x {0, 1, 2}^k, Delta_X - Delta_Y = -3 sum_l epsilon_l (1_(t_l=1) - 1_(u_l=1)) is divisible by 3 over Z, and (Delta_X, Delta_Y) === (sum_l epsilon_l (u_l - t_l)) * (1, 1) (mod 3). Because sum_l epsilon_l (u_l - t_l) mod 3 is uniform on Z_3 for every k >= 1, exactly 9^k / 3 = 3^(2k - 1) ordered path pairs satisfy v_3(Delta) >= 1 and 2 * 3^(2k - 1) pairs satisfy v_3(Delta) = 0, giving an all-site mod-3 survival fraction of (1/3)^M = 3^(-M) for all k >= 1.
